conditions: Applies only to the existing approved PRD/TRD/Design Baseline and the already-defined slice requirements and exclusions; it does not authorize product scope expansion.
Permits necessary UI/UX work within approved scope, Superpowers execution, deterministic tests, review, CI/security fixes and bounded refactoring required to pass gates.
Material architecture or policy decisions that require evidence remain separate human decisions, including DEC-003 and DEC-004.
Certification is not pre-approved and must bind the exact tested 40-character commit SHA.
Merge of certification candidates is not pre-approved by this standing authorization.
Release, deployment and production-enable are not authorized.

One active vertical slice remains the default; future slice activation may translate this standing authorization into typed scope/implementation approvals only after dependencies and blocking decisions are satisfied.
